grammarFocus: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门。
title: Healthy Habits and Rest: A Conversation at the Park
instructions: 本材料为项目原创模拟教学材料，情境和数据均为模拟，非官方试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先读题，再听录音；建议第一遍抓大意，第二遍核对细节。共 10 题；单选题只选一个完整选项。填空用录音中的英文原词或数字，遵守每题词数限制。判断题 True 表示原文明示支持，False 表示原文明示矛盾，Not Given 表示缺少判断所需信息。
transcript:
Mei: Hi Tom! You look tired. Are you okay?
Tom: I'm fine, but I slept badly last night. I drank coffee after dinner. So I couldn't sleep well.
Mei: You could try coffee earlier in the day. You should put your phone away before bed too.
Tom: You're right. I should change that habit. I usually go to bed at 12:30 a.m. because I watch videos on my phone.
Mei: That's late. I go to bed at 10 p.m. and get up at 6 a.m. So I sleep for eight hours.
Tom: I sleep for about five hours. That's why I'm often tired.
Mei: Sleep is important. Eight hours is better than five for me.
Tom: I should also exercise more. I walk for forty minutes every day.
Mei: I walk for ten minutes to the bus stop and thirty minutes in the park. My total is forty minutes too.
Tom: So we walk for the same amount of time. What about food?
Mei: I eat vegetables every day.
Tom: I don't eat many vegetables. I should eat more.
Mei: I drink two liters of water every day as well.
Tom: I drink about one liter a day. I often forget to take a bottle to work.
Mei: I keep one in my bag. Water is the best drink for your health, in my opinion.
Tom: Thanks. You give good advice. I'll start by putting my phone away earlier and taking water to work.

questions.prompt: Why did Tom sleep badly last night?
questions.explanation: Tom说：“I drank coffee after dinner. So I couldn't sleep well.” 所以正确答案是“He drank coffee after dinner.”
questions.evidence: I drank coffee after dinner. So I couldn't sleep well.

questions.prompt: What time does Mei go to bed?
questions.explanation: Mei说：“I go to bed at 10 p.m.” 所以正确答案是“At 10 p.m.”
questions.evidence: I go to bed at 10 p.m. and get up at 6 a.m.

questions.prompt: Tom usually goes to bed at ______ a.m. (Copy the time in figures, for example 9:30.)
questions.explanation: Tom说：“I usually go to bed at 12:30 a.m.” 所以填空答案是“12:30”。
questions.evidence: I usually go to bed at 12:30 a.m.

questions.prompt: How many hours does Mei sleep?
questions.explanation: Mei说：“So I sleep for eight hours.” 所以正确答案是“Eight hours.”
questions.evidence: So I sleep for eight hours.

questions.prompt: How long does Tom walk every day?
questions.explanation: Tom说：“I walk for forty minutes every day.” 所以正确答案是“Forty minutes.”
questions.evidence: I walk for forty minutes every day.

questions.prompt: Mei drinks ______ liters of water every day. (Write ONE WORD from the recording.)
questions.explanation: Mei 明确说每天喝 two 升水；按录音原词填 two。
questions.evidence: I drink two liters of water every day as well.

questions.prompt: Tom drinks about one liter of water every day.
questions.explanation: Tom 明确说每天大约喝一升水，因此该陈述得到原文支持。
questions.evidence: I drink about one liter a day.

questions.prompt: Mei walks longer than Tom every day.
questions.explanation: Mei 明确说她每天总共走四十分钟，和 Tom 一样久，并非更久。
questions.evidence: I walk for ten minutes to the bus stop and thirty minutes in the park. My total is forty minutes too.

questions.explanation: “吃得不多”不能推出“不是每天吃”。录音没有说明 Tom 是否每天吃蔬菜，因此选 Not Given。
questions.evidence: 未说明 Tom 吃蔬菜的频率；原文只有“I don't eat many vegetables.”，只说明量少。

questions.prompt: What does Mei personally consider the best drink for health?
questions.explanation: Mei说：“Water is the best drink for your health.” 所以正确答案是“Water.”
questions.evidence: Water is the best drink for your health, in my opinion.

vocabulary.example: I sleep for about five hours.
Water is the best drink for your health, in my opinion.

grammar.title: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: because 表示原因，so 表示结果。should 表示“应该”，用于给建议。比较级用于比较两者，如 better than；最高级用于三者或以上，如 the best。
grammar.example: I drank coffee after dinner. So I couldn't sleep well.

questions.prompt: 表示结果，选择合适的词：I missed the bus, ______ I walked home.
questions.explanation: 前面说明原因，后面说明结果，用 so。
questions.evidence: I missed the bus, so I walked home.

questions.prompt: 给出“应该多喝水”的正面建议：You ______ drink more water.
questions.explanation: should 表示建议“应该”；shouldn't 表示“不应该”，can't 表示“不能”。
than 提示比较两者；heavy 的比较级为 heavier。
questions.evidence: My bag is heavier than yours.

questions.prompt: Of these three bags, this is the ______.
questions.explanation: 明确在三个包中比较，用最高级 heaviest。
questions.evidence: Of these three bags, this is the heaviest.
